mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(username, password_hash, department_id, role) VALUES (#{username}, #{hash}, #{departmentId}, #{role}) ON CONFLICT (username) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_department WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted = false AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_department(code, name) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
